worked_solution:
Let's examine each matrix in turn.

- Since $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix, its determinant is:

$$
det(A)=3\cdot 1-2\cdot (-1)=5
$$

- Since $B$ has two identical rows, we obtain

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}0.17 & \sqrt{5} & 4 \\ 2 & -3 & 6 \\ 2 & -3 & 6\end{aligned}]\,⟹\,det(B)=0.
$$

Therefore, $2det(A)+3det(B)=2\cdot 5+3\cdot 0=10.$
